introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Food and Nutrition 2 (0540), ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2023. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Instructions to candidates: ANSWER ANY FOUR QUESTIONS.

You are reminded of the necessity of good English and orderly presentation of work. Tabulate wherever possible and use diagrams where appropriate.
incertitudes: Règle de choix : la page de garde imprime « ANSWER ANY FOUR QUESTIONS » (4 sur 6 questions imprimées), sans section et sans mention « only the first four will be marked ». `groupes` = ["PAPER 2"] et `regles_choix` = parmi 4 sur 6, identiques dans les 6 fichiers.

Sujet scanné de 2 pages (page de garde et six questions sur une page), lu en image ; aucun schéma ni figure imprimé, donc `figures` vide dans tous les fichiers. Filigranes (gcerevision.com, Kawlo) ignorés. L'en-tête imprimé « Food &Nutrition 2 » est recopié en « Food and Nutrition 2 » dans l'introduction.

Points : chaque question imprime « Total = (25 marks) » ; les points des sous-questions imprimés totalisent bien 25 pour chacune des 6 questions (aucun écart). Pour 2(d), 3(a), 3(d), 4(c) et 5(a), `points` de la sous-question est la somme des parties (i) et (ii) imprimées (3+2, 2+3, 5+5, 4+4, 2+5).

Aucun corrigé officiel : les corrigés sont des réponses modèles rédigées au nombre exact d'éléments demandés (cinq, quatre, sept, huit...). D'autres réponses sont valables pour les questions de liste (types de repas, plats camerounais, équipements, signes de vieillissement de l'oeuf...) ; le barème d'un point par élément est une hypothèse, le sujet ne le détaille pas. La répartition des 10 points de 2(b) (2 par groupe) et de 6(a) (2,5 par équipement) est aussi une hypothèse.

Faits de cours à relire par un enseignant de Food and Nutrition : la liste des groupes de légumes (le sujet n'en impose aucune), les changements de l'oeuf qui vieillit (le sujet demande sept, d'autres manuels en donnent d'autres) et la température usuelle d'un congélateur (environ -18 degrés C). Aucune teneur nutritive ni durée de conservation chiffrée n'est avancée, sauf l'énergie d'un gramme de protéine (environ 17 kJ, valeur du programme).

Fautes d'impression du sujet recopiées telles quelles : « State five(5) reasons » (1a), « pastry making . » (1d), « first aid box . » (3a ii), « State five (5) qualities of a good waiter? » (4a), « importance of studying » au singulier après « five (5) » (3d ii, 5a ii), « vegetables salads » (2d ii), « left-over foods » (6b).

questions.enonce_markdown:
State five(5) points to remember when preparing food for a patient

(5 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Five points (1 mark each):

1. **Follow the advice of the doctor or dietitian** and give only the foods and drinks that are allowed for the illness.
2. **Choose light foods that are easy to digest** (soft, well cooked and not too fatty or highly spiced).
3. **Serve small, attractive meals** at regular intervals, because a sick person has a poor appetite; hot food must be served hot and cold food cold.
4. **Make the food nutritious** (enough protein, vitamins and minerals, and plenty of fluids) to help the patient to recover.
5. **Observe strict hygiene** in preparing, cooking and serving, because the patient is weak and easily infected; also consider the patient's likes and dislikes.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Classify vegetables in five groups giving an example each.

(10 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Vegetables are classified according to the part of the plant that is eaten (2 marks for each group with its example):

| Group | Part of the plant eaten | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Leaf vegetables | Leaves | Cabbage, lettuce, spinach |
| Root vegetables | Swollen root | Carrot, beetroot |
| Bulb vegetables | Swollen leaf bases of an underground bud | Onion, garlic |
| Fruit vegetables | Fruit of the plant | Tomato, okra, garden egg, cucumber |
| Flower vegetables | Flower head | Cauliflower, broccoli |

(Other groups, which could also be used, are stem vegetables such as celery, and seed and pod vegetables such as peas and green beans.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
Explain the steps for making cake using the creaming method.

(5 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
The **creaming method** is used for rich cakes such as Victoria sandwich cake, where the fat and sugar are beaten together to trap air.

1. **Prepare.** Grease and line the cake tin, heat the oven to moderate, weigh the ingredients accurately and take the fat out so that it is soft (but not melted).
2. **Cream the fat and sugar.** Beat them together with a wooden spoon (or an electric whisk) until the mixture is pale, light and fluffy. This traps air, which makes the cake light.
3. **Add the eggs.** Beat the eggs and add them a little at a time, beating well after each addition, so that the mixture does not curdle (if it begins to curdle, add a spoonful of flour).
4. **Fold in the flour.** Sift the flour with the baking powder and fold it in lightly with a metal spoon, adding a little milk if necessary to get a soft dropping consistency. Do not beat, because the air would be lost.
5. **Bake.** Put the mixture in the prepared tin, level the top and bake in a moderate oven until the cake is risen, golden brown and springs back when pressed (a skewer comes out clean). Cool on a wire rack.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) Outline three (3) roles of herbs to man.

(3 marks)

(ii) Name four (4) main ingredients for making vegetables salads.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Three roles of herbs to man (1 mark each).**

1. **They give flavour and a pleasant smell to food** (for example thyme, basil, parsley, mint).
2. **They are used to garnish and decorate dishes,** giving colour and a fresh look.
3. **They are used as traditional medicine,** for example to relieve a cold, a stomach ache or to help digestion.

**(ii) Four main ingredients of a vegetable salad (0.5 mark each).**

1. Lettuce (or cabbage)
2. Tomatoes
3. Cucumber
4. Carrots
